business_summary: H.B. Fuller Company, together with its subsidiaries, formulates, manufactures, and markets adhesives, sealants, coatings, polymers, tapes, encapsulants, additives, and other specialty chemical products. It operates through three segments: Hygiene, Health and Consumable Adhesives; Engineering Adhesives; and Building Adhesive Solutions. The Hygiene, Health and Consumable Adhesives segment produces and supplies specialty industrial adhesives, such as thermoplastic, thermoset, reactive, water-based, and solvent-based products for applications in various markets, including packaging, converting, nonwoven and hygiene, and medical and beauty. The Engineering Adhesives segment produces and supplies high performance industrial adhesives comprising reactive, light cure, two-part liquids, polyurethane, silicone, film, and fast cure products to the durable assembly, performance wood and textile, transportation, electronics, clean energy, aerospace and defense, appliance, heavy machinery, and insulating glass markets. The Construction Adhesives segment provides products used for commercial roofing, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning and insulation applications, as well as caulks and sealants for the consumer market and professional trade. The company sells its products directly to customers, as well as through distributors and retailers in North America, Latin America, Europe, India, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. H.B. Fuller Company was founded in 1887 and is headquartered in Saint Paul, Minnesota.
business_summary_ko: H.B. Fuller Company는 자회사와 함께 접착제, 밀봉제, 코팅제, 폴리머, 테이프, 캡슐화제, 첨가제 및 기타 특수 화학 제품을 제조, 제조 및 판매합니다. 위생, 건강 및 소모품 접착제의 세 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 엔지니어링 접착제; 및 건축용 접착제 솔루션. 위생, 건강 및 소모품 접착제 부문은 포장, 변환, 부직포 및 위생, 의료 및 미용을 포함한 다양한 시장에 적용되는 열가소성, 열경화성, 반응성, 수성 및 용제 기반 제품과 같은 특수 산업용 접착제를 생산 및 공급합니다. 엔지니어링 접착제 부문은 반응성, 광경화, 2액형 액체, 폴리우레탄, 실리콘, 필름 및 속경화 제품으로 구성된 고성능 산업용 접착제를 생산하여 내구성 조립, 고성능 목재 및 직물, 운송, 전자, 청정 에너지, 항공우주 및 방위, 가전제품, 중장비 및 절연 유리 시장에 공급합니다. 건축용 접착제 부문은 상업용 지붕, 난방, 환기, 공조 및 단열 응용 분야뿐만 아니라 코크 및 바다에도 사용되는 제품을 제공합니다.
